name: Telangana Common Schedule of Rates 2026-27 — Part III (Building Works)
department: Board of Chief Engineers (I&CAD, R&B, Buildings, Public Health), Government of Telangana
source_ref: Government of Telangana, Common Schedule of Rates for the year 2026-27 (effective 1 June 2026), finalised by the Board of Chief Engineers on 25.05.2026 & 31.05.2026 — https://www.pred.telangana.gov.in/uploads/documents/doc-1786011352680-dce1d071-2aba-40d8-92c2-5dc6ef1cd301.pdf
notes: Part III (Building Works) item rates as printed (pages 111-355). Rates include contractor's profit & overheads as stated in the SOR. Area allowances on the LABOUR component apply by location (Common Preamble 1): Greater Hyderabad +40%, other Municipal Corporations +25%, District Headquarters / other municipalities +20%, notified industrial areas +20%, agency/tribal areas per GO. Labour shares are not printed per item, so these allowances are not applied automatically. Includes Part-1 basic material rates (codes P1-) and the common labour rates 2026-27 per GO MS No.6 LAB-I dt 30.05.2026 in three zones (codes LAB-<category>-<sl>-Z1/Z2/Z3).
